stem:
What do these sentences show about Layla?

Take only pictures. Leave only footprints.
The tour guide's words played over and over in Layla's mind.

options.label: F
options.text: She wants to take pictures of the geode.

options.label: G
options.text: She is good at recalling important ideas.

options.label: H
options.text: She is not sure what the tour guide meant.

options.label: J
options.text: She is considering what she should do with the geode.
